io_cost_enabled.description: Enable the I/O cost model globally. Set to false to disable blkcg I/O cost control.

io_cost_weight.description: Global default weight used for I/O cost calculation. Higher values get relatively more bandwidth.

io_cost_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for I/O cost computation. Currently only 'linear' is supported by systemd.

io_cost_devices.description: List of block devices to assign custom I/O weights. Each entry specifies a device and optional per-device weight.

device_path.description: Full path to the block device (e.g., /dev/sda1, /dev/disk/by-id/ata-...). Must match a real block device on the system.

weight.description: Optional per-device weight (integer). If omitted, the global `io_cost_weight` is used.
